title: bandsolver: Newman's BAND block-tridiagonal solver in Fortran and C++ with Python bindings
description: Standalone implementation of John Newman's BAND algorithm (Electrochemical Systems, 3rd ed., Appendix C) for coupled, nonlinear one-dimensional boundary-value and transient problems. It provides a block-tridiagonal solver with endpoint coupling blocks, a Newton driver, and finite-difference Jacobians, in Fortran 2008 (with a C ABI) and C++17, both accessible from Python.
